ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Date/time on which the calculation is based. For example: valuation on October 1 (price date) based on price of September 19 ( value date).

ValuePeriod.name: Value Period
ValuePeriod.definition: Period on which the calculation is based.

EstimatedInterestRate.name: Estimated Interest Rate
EstimatedInterestRate.definition: Estimated per annum ratio of interest paid to the principal amount of the financial instrument for a specific period of time.

VariableRateValueDate.name: Variable Rate Value Date
VariableRateValueDate.definition: Date/time as of which the variable rate is valid.

SecuritiesPricing.name: Securities Pricing
SecuritiesPricing.definition: Pricing for which an analytics calculation is specified.

Value.name: Value
Value.definition: Result of the defined analytics calculation.
